notes: theme.css is a color-only layer: ChatGPT design tokens are declared once on <html> and inherited by every element, because ChatGPT redefines them on every element under its dark root.
Composer, code block and writing block roots re-point the page tokens to their own palette color; everything inside inherits it.
Only background-color and border-color are overridden directly, on surfaces ChatGPT paints without a matching token.
Removed all layout overrides from 2.x: assistant message cards, table sizing, content-visibility, z-index on the composer container and the start-at-bottom scroll timers.
The previous z-index on #thread-bottom-container lifted the page composer above the image editor, which showed two message boxes.
data-oled is removed while the theme is active and restored when the theme is disabled.
The theme applies while ChatGPT is in its dark appearance; light mode keeps the native look and the popup shows a note.

Verified in Chromium with the unpacked extension against a synthetic page that mimics ChatGPT's per-element dark tokens, bottom fade, composer, image editor overlay, code block and writing block markup; not against the authenticated live site.
